thread:
alex: Urgent - on a demo call the customer hit a 403 when switching projects in the console after the Okta group sync. They were an Owner yesterday.

jess: Can you paste exact repro and the error copy? Is it all members of their Okta group or a subset?

alex: Repro: 1) SSO login -> 2) open Console -> 3) project dropdown -> 4) select 'acme-prod' -> 403 page. Error: '403 Forbidden - You do not have permission to view this project.' Customer says ~4 users affected, others ok. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/console-403-acme.png

devon: Any SCIM/group-sync failures around the push window? I saw retries last night.

opsbot: scim-sync-job #12981 status: FAILED -> rate_limit_exceeded on batch 18 (retry scheduled)

alex: Audit snippet from the SCIM job (PII redacted):
```
{"event":"SCIM_GROUP_UPDATE","group":"acme-engineers","okta_event_id":"okta_evt_12981","timestamp":"2026-02-18T02:12:44Z","changes":[{"op":"replace","members_added":[],"members_removed":["sarah@acme.com"]}]}
```
Customer insists Sarah was in that group before the update.

sre-oncall: I can run a role propagation for proj-acme-prod, but want the audit ID first. If the sync created a new group id we might have orphaned rolebindings.

devon: That matches a pattern - when Okta changes group externalId/immutableId we create a new internal group record; existing project rolebindings still point to the old group uuid -> users show in IdP but RBAC doesn't resolve. We call this 'shadowing'.

security: Short-term fix: grant Sarah a Maintainer role on the project directly (console or Admin API). Not ideal but unblocks the demo. Long-term we should reconcile by externalId and provide a merge path for renamed groups.

sre-oncall: Running: 
```
./tools/rbac-propagate --project proj-acme-prod --mode force --dry-run=false
```
Posting output shortly.

alex: Propagate output: 12/16 rolebindings reconciled, 4 failed with 'group not found (old-group-uuid)'. For Sarah the group resolution returned 404 when fetching old-group-uuid.

jess: I'll escalate to eng-runtime, creating INF-4521 and attaching the SCIM logs, the propagate output, and the audit snippet. Customer is on a demo call - mark P0.

eng-runtime: Acknowledged. We'll need the scim-sync job logs and the exact mappings for group.externalId -> internal_group_id. Will replicate locally and propose a safe merge operation.

devon: For infra change: prefer matching on externalId first, but also add a reconciliation routine that can detect display-name-only renames and offer a safe merge confirmation before altering bindings.

alex: Applied the mitigation: added Sarah directly to Maintainer on the project via admin API. Customer confirmed access restored and demo continued.

sre-oncall: Manual add done and logged. Created INF-4521 with errors from rbac-propagate and scim-sync-job #12981.

jess: INF-4521: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4521 - includes logs and next-steps. Please add a postmortem and a remediation ETA.

alex: I'll follow up with the account team and update the customer. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
